flags.title: Template staging conflicts with SKILL.md for tracked paths
flags.detail: SKILL.md removal flow step 3 prescribes `git mv` (plain mv only for untracked) and calls quarantine 'a normal commit in the owning repo', with a pre-quarantine commit checklist (message names receipt class + evidence pointer, identity souji-shokunin <souji@shokunin.local>). The plan template prefers 'plain mv … to avoid index churn' and step_2_hold says 'no commit'. For a TRACKED path plain mv leaves the owning repo dirty over the original path (deletion + untracked copy), which fails gate2 for the whole hold and skips the commit checklist. Nothing executes this round, so no violation occurred — fix the template before any future execution: tracked -> git mv + commit; untracked -> plain mv.

flags.title: step_3 second check cannot pass for pushed-class tickets as written (S18's second_check_trap)
flags.detail: The template re-runs the receipt tools on the quarantined copy. After a lawful git mv, the quarantine commit becomes the introducing commit of the moved path and touches both paths, so the pushed receipt is unestablishable at the new location by construction (tools/souji-verify.sh:220,230-234 mechanism, fixture-probed by S18). Second check must instead re-verify the ORIGINAL path's receipt and gates at decision time plus stability of the quarantine location — otherwise step 5 of the documented flow can never be satisfied even when everything was done correctly. Corroborates S18 (seat-18.json second_check_trap); the spec/SKILL fix must land with the flow flip.

flags.title: Hold-period floor unstated in template
flags.detail: SKILL.md step 4 requires hold ≥ one driver tick (450s minimum; prefer 24h for non-pushed). Template's 'hold window = this round' satisfies it in spirit but should state the 450s floor and the 24h preference explicitly so a future execution cannot shortcut it.
